services: two separate real Windows server processes, HTTP/TCP loopback, JSON-RPC and SSE

analysis.scope: actual local simulation results; no robot actuation; no autonomous model retraining
analysis.recommendation: Keep random/interval baselines; do not use confidence alone as a training-value guarantee

task_restore_scope: completed tasks restored after actual process termination/restart; in-flight worker restart not implemented
disconnect_scope: SSE client disconnect while working; server continued and GetTask returned completed
idempotency_scope: application-level content-addressed result reuse for sequential duplicate requests, not a universal A2A exactly-once guarantee
